Title: Equivalence of Definitions of Complex Inverse Hyperbolic Sine

{{TFAE|def = Complex Inverse Hyperbolic Sine}}

=== [[Definition:Inverse Hyperbolic Sine/Complex/Definition 1|Definition 1]] ===
The '''inverse hyperbolic sine''' is a [[Definition:Multifunction|multifunction]] defined as:

:$\forall z \in \C: \map {\sinh^{-1} } z := \set {w \in \C: z = \map \sinh w}$

where $\map \sinh w$ is the [[Definition:Hyperbolic Sine|hyperbolic sine function]].
=== [[Definition:Inverse Hyperbolic Sine/Complex/Definition 2|Definition 2]] ===
The '''inverse hyperbolic sine''' is a [[Definition:Multifunction|multifunction]] defined as:

:$\forall z \in \C: \map {\sinh^{-1} } z := \set {\map \ln {z + \sqrt {\size {z^2 + 1} } e^{\paren {i / 2} \map \arg {z^2 + 1} } } + 2 k \pi i: k \in \Z}$

where:
:$\sqrt {\size {z^2 + 1} }$ denotes the [[Definition:Positive Square Root|positive square root]] of the [[Definition:Complex Modulus|complex modulus]] of $z^2 + 1$
:$\map \arg {z^2 + 1}$ denotes the [[Definition:Argument of Complex Number|argument]] of $z^2 + 1$
:$\ln$ denotes the [[Definition:Complex Natural Logarithm|complex natural logarithm]] considered as a  [[Definition:Multifunction|multifunction]].
